summary: Frontend testing of home page refactoring: CuraStories removal, BrandShowcase carousel, GoogleReviews section. All features working correctly. Found 1 HTML validity issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button> - carousel dots are buttons inside main slide button
ui_bugs.console_error: In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.

action_items: FIX BrandShowcase.jsx: Change carousel dot buttons from <button> to <span role='button'> or move dots outside the main <button> to fix HTML validity and potential hydration errors
critical_code_review_comments: BrandShowcase.jsx lines 165-222: Main carousel slide is a <button> with nested <button> elements for dots. Fix by: (1) changing dots to <span role='button' tabIndex={0}> or (2) restructuring to place dots outside the main button element
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested home page refactoring: 1) CuraStories removed - confirmed not present, 2) BrandShowcase carousel with 4 slides (DiaGyn, Mango, Orange + Summer campaign for March), auto-rotates every 4.5s, dots clickable, 3) GoogleReviews section with 4.8 rating, 5 review cards, scroll buttons, 'Rate us on Google' CTA, 4) HealthStreak widget still works (regression OK), 5) FooterBadge still works (regression OK). Only issue is nested buttons in BrandShowcase causing console warnings.
